description: Detects repeated denied MFA push prompts for one user in a short window. Attackers with a stolen password spam push requests hoping the user approves one out of annoyance (MFA fatigue / push bombing).

detection.logic_plain_english: Count MFA prompts with result 'denied' grouped by user. Alert when a user denies 3 or more prompts within any rolling 15-minute window.

false_positive_notes: Users with a new phone or a flaky authenticator app can deny repeatedly. Still worth a quick out-of-band check with the user: if they say the prompts were not theirs, treat as an incident and force a password reset.
log_source: IdP MFA logs (Entra ID sign-in logs / authenticator service)
name: Multiple MFA prompts denied (possible MFA fatigue attack)
